### About me

I came to data engineering through a biomedical engineering background. I spent a few years analyzing electrograms and ECG signals before realizing I liked the "finding structure in messy systems" part more than the "systems" part. That instinct carried straight over: today I build pipelines and BI platforms instead of signal-processing models, but it's the same job, turning noisy inputs into something trustworthy.

### Now @ ELFO Srl (2026 – present)

- 🏥 Building a **Databricks + Fabric** data platform for a public healthcare organization, ingesting multiple Oracle clinical and administrative sources into a governed lakehouse
- 🔄 Rebuilding legacy Qlik reporting as **Power BI** reports on a Databricks lakehouse, as part of a manufacturing client's ERP migration to JD Edwards
- 📊 Delivering BI for a global consumer goods company's sales performance platform and CRM integration dashboards for an industrial group
- 🤖 Developing an internal library of ~50 **AI agent skills** for Power BI development (PBIP / PBIR / TMDL): DAX authoring, model optimization, report formatting, documentation, plus tested Deneb chart templates
